name: ESO 059-01 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 059-01, an isolated irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso05901-hubble
story: A lone irregular galaxy with no group to call home. Hubble imaged it in a survey of nearby galaxies, using its red giant stars to measure how far away it is.

claims.text: E059-01 is ESO 059-01, imaged with ACS in HST program GO-9771
ESO 059-01 is an isolated irregular galaxy
Its distance was measured from the tip of the red giant branch
